A few good questions

Glad you asked.

A little clarity before you get started.

Do my customers need to download an app?

No separate SKANNI customer app is planned. Customers add the pass through the wallet flow on their device, keeping the experience friction-light and familiar.

Does it work with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?

Those are the intended wallet destinations. SKANNI is designed around compatibility with both ecosystems, with final setup handled in the merchant dashboard.

How do I manage the program?

The private merchant dashboard will handle program setup, branding, and subscription access. This public page is a marketing site only and does not expose account management.
